modules.purpose: Create, validate, and serialize projects with voices, accents, avatars, backgrounds, brands, and scenes
modules.consumer_contract: VideoProject.from_dict(data) returns a typed project; validate() rejects invalid or unconsented input; to_dict() is JSON-serializable.

modules.purpose: Plan, revise, and approve an editable one-prompt video
modules.consumer_contract: ProjectWorkflow.from_env() selects the configured agent or honest deterministic planner and returns projects that require explicit approval before render.

modules.purpose: Render a complete validated avatar-video artifact
modules.consumer_contract: RenderEngine(...).render(approved_project, output_dir) returns completed_verified only after model, composition, audio, duration, and motion validation.

modules.purpose: Store/filter voices and reuse consented avatars and templates
modules.consumer_contract: Catalog searches return typed voice profiles; avatar records detect asset mutation; templates revalidate the resulting project.

modules.purpose: Persist editable studio projects, revisions, and reusable brand kits
modules.consumer_contract: StudioProjectStore.save(project, expected_revision=...) performs validated optimistic versioning; BrandKitStore saves and returns typed brand/glossary records.

modules.purpose: Create a real bidirectional conversational avatar session
modules.consumer_contract: HttpLiveAvatarProvider.create(...) returns a validated HTTPS/WSS session for a configured engine, while LiveSessionStore persists lifecycle metadata without room URLs or tokens.

integration_example: from avatar_twin import ProjectWorkflow, RenderEngine, VideoProject; workflow = ProjectWorkflow.from_env(); project = workflow.plan(VideoProject.from_dict(data)); project = workflow.approve(project); artifact = RenderEngine(asset_root, runtime_config='runtime.local.json').render(project, output_dir)
